description: This file defines the delete operation for articles in the Conduit feature. It contains a command structure, validation logic, and a handler for executing the delete by slug, interacting with Entity Framework Core for database operations.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug provided in the delete command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete request by locating the article with the specified slug and removing it from the database.

methods.name: Delete.CommandValidator.Trigger
methods.description: Constructor that sets validation rules for the command.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the delete operation asynchronously, throwing an exception if the article is not found.
